# forgejo_action_runner (Resource)

Manages a global or organization-scoped Forgejo Actions runner identity. Runner processes and their self-reported labels remain outside this resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Runner name.
- `scope` (String) Runner scope: global or organization.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Runner description.
- `ephemeral` (Boolean) Whether Forgejo removes the runner after it completes one job.
- `owner` (String) Organization name for an organization-scoped runner; omit for a global runner.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric runner identifier.
- `labels` (Set of String) Labels self-reported by the connected runner.
- `status` (String) Runner connection status.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Runner authentication token, returned only when Forgejo creates the runner.
- `uuid` (String) Runner UUID.
- `version` (String) Runner-reported version.
